observations.behavior: Adds explicit export to the file-scoped constant ABSOLUTE_FILE_TAG_REGEX, making it available to other modules.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the shared regex, used to extract file-path mentions from user input, to be imported and reused in other packages.

observations.behavior: Adds explicit export to the file-scoped function normalizePromptText, making it available to other modules.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the shared text-normalization helper, used to clean prompt text, to be imported and reused in other packages.

observations.behavior: Adds a new exported function stripAttachmentSummaryOf, which conditionally removes a trailing attachment summary only when every named file is present in a supplied set of labels.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a shared utility to avoid displaying attachment summaries that reference files not actually attached, supporting the message-processing pipeline.
